scope: Germany V9 first-pass CPO tariff audit
guardrails: No tariff generalized beyond the explicit official source scope.
Third-party station data is discovery/supporting evidence only unless the official CPO source confirms the tariff.
Previously deferred CPOs are not re-audited without new evidence.

cpos.direct_payment: Official adhocLADEN tariff published for the Stadtwerke Heilbronn charging network.
cpos.scope_note: Official SWHN e-mobility page explicitly labels the tariff adhocLADEN and separates it from the dauerLADEN subscriber tariff. The published blocking-fee caps are preserved exactly.

cpos.canonical_name: öPA Verkehrsgesellschaft mbH / Stadtwerke Troisdorf charging network
cpos.direct_payment: Official Troisdorf charging page publishes ad-hoc AC and DC prices. Since 2026 the sister company öPA Verkehrsgesellschaft mbH operates the public and commercial charging infrastructure; the service/tariff surface remains the Stadtwerke Troisdorf e-mobility page.
cpos.scope_note: The official station page labels the prices as Ad-Hoc Laden for Troisdorf stations and warns that stations outside Troisdorf can have different operator prices. No out-of-area price is generalized. The 2026 operator transfer to öPA is retained as a canonical alias/authority transition rather than treated as a second tariff identity.

cpos.direct_payment: Current official surface found for MobilWatt card/app charging, but not a current no-contract ad-hoc checkout tariff.
cpos.reason: The official MobilWatt page publishes contract/card prices and still labels the displayed charging tariff as valid from 2022. It does not establish that those values are the current spontaneous/direct ad-hoc tariff in 2026. Household electricity prices are unrelated and are not substituted.
cpos.unlock_needed: Official public QR/web checkout for a Stadtwerke Unna EVSE, or an authoritative station-level direct-payment tariff feed with current validity and blocking conditions.
